Please post on our forums:

for questions about using the `thinkNXG Framework`: https://discuss.thinknxg.com or [stackoverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/frappe) tagged under `frappe`

for questions about using `thinkNXG ERP`: https://discuss.thinknxg.com

for questions about using `bench`, probably the best place to start is the [bench repo](https://github.com/frappe/bench)

For documentation issues, use the [thinkNXG Framework Documentation](https://docs.thinknxg.com/thinknxgframework) or the [developer cheetsheet](https://github.com/thinknxg/thinknxg/wiki/Developer-Cheatsheet)

For a slightly outdated yet informative developer guide: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3lFfCEoMxvzHtsZHFJ4T3n5yMM3nGJ1W

> **Posts that are not bug reports or feature requests will not be addressed on this issue tracker.**
